tasks.completion_summary: Fixed orphaned processes surviving daemon restart by preserving PID tracker across graceful stops instead of clearing it. Added 2 e2e tests for PID tracker persistence and port cleanup on autostart.

Fixed Windows UI deadlock on panel close by removing termOverlay.Redraw() from the OutputGate onUnfreeze callback in run_windows.go. hideMenu holds overlay.mu when calling gate.Unfreeze(), and Redraw() also locks overlay.mu, causing a deadlock. The callers already handle redrawing after Unfreeze returns.

Fixed stale process panel header by syncing ProcessState from daemon status on each 750ms refresh tick, forcing full redraw when state changes so header reflects current running/failed state instead of stale failure from previous attempt.
